+
+    def test_version_seven_migration_preserves_notes_and_status(self):
+        rows = [
+            {"id": status, "title": status, "description": "", "status": status,
+             "priority": "HIGH", "created_at": CREATED_AT, "due_date": None,
+             "tags": ["work"], "source": "original", "category": "work",
+             "notes": ["first", "first"]}
+            for status in ("pending", "completed")
+        ]
+        self.store.path.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 7, "records": rows}),
+                                   encoding="utf-8")
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("migrate"), {"migrated": 2})
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("list"), [{**row, "archived": False} for row in rows])
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("list-archived"), [])
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("migrate"), {"migrated": 0})
+
+    def test_archive_hides_both_statuses_from_all_regular_lists(self):
+        pending = self.cli("create", "--title", "Pending", "--description", "",
+                           "--priority", "HIGH", "--tag", "work", "--category", "work",
+                           "--due-date", "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z")
+        completed = self.cli("create", "--title", "Completed", "--description", "",
+                             "--priority", "HIGH", "--tag", "work", "--category", "work",
+                             "--due-date", "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z")
+        remaining = self.cli("create", "--title", "Visible", "--description", "",
+                             "--priority", "HIGH", "--tag", "work", "--category", "work",
+                             "--due-date", "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z")
+        self.cli("complete", "--id", completed["id"])
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("archive", "--id", pending["id"]),
+                         {**pending, "archived": True})
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("archive", "--id", completed["id"]),
+                         {**completed, "status": "completed", "archived": True})
+        self.store.save(list(reversed(self.store.load())))
+        before = self.store.path.read_bytes()
+        archived = self.cli("list-archived")
+        self.assertEqual(archived, sorted(archived, key=lambda t: (t["created_at"], t["id"])))
+        self.assertEqual({task["id"] for task in archived}, {pending["id"], completed["id"]})
+        for command in (("list",), ("list-high",), ("list-overdue",),
+                        ("list-tag", "--tag", "work"),
+                        ("list-status", "--status", "pending"),
+                        ("list-status", "--status", "completed"),
+                        ("list-category", "--category", "work")):
+            with self.subTest(command=command):
+                results = self.cli(*command)
+                self.assertEqual([task["id"] for task in results],
+                                 [] if command == ("list-status", "--status", "completed")
+                                 else [remaining["id"]])
+        self.assertEqual(self.store.path.read_bytes(), before)
+
+    def test_repeated_archive_and_missing_id_do_not_write(self):
+        created = self.cli("create", "--title", "Task", "--description", "")
+        self.cli("archive", "--id", created["id"])
+        before = self.store.path.read_bytes()
+        for task_id, error in ((created["id"], "invalid_transition"),
+                               ("missing", "task_not_found")):
+            with self.subTest(task_id=task_id):
+                result = subprocess.run(
+                    [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "archive", "--id", task_id],
+                    cwd=self.directory.name, capture_output=True, text=True,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+                self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stderr), {"error": error})
+                self.assertEqual(self.store.path.read_bytes(), before)
+
+    def test_archived_state_requires_boolean(self):
+        created = self.cli("create", "--title", "Task", "--description", "")
+        payload = json.loads(self.store.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        for invalid in (0, "false", None):
+            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid):
+                payload["records"][0]["archived"] = invalid
+                self.store.path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
+                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "list"],
+                                        cwd=self.directory.name, capture_output=True, text=True)
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+                self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stderr), {"error": "invalid_state"})
*** End Patch

Implemented B08 in the isolated Conventional workspace. The six existing list commands hide archived tasks, and `list-archived` shows them in normal order.
